title: Chicken Gapples
description: Chicken Nugget Gapples replaces Golden Apples and Enchanted Golden Apples with tasty chicken nuggets. Perfect for meme packs, PvP, and casual gameplay, this simple texture pack lets you heal and survive using everyone's favorite snack!
body:
**Chicken Gapples**

This resource pack replaces the textures of Golden Apples and Enchanted Golden Apples with chicken nuggets.

The pack only changes the appearance of these items and does not modify gameplay, effects, crafting recipes, or item behavior.

Features
Golden Apple → Chicken Nugget
Enchanted Golden Apple → Enchanted Chicken Nugget
Texture-only resource pack
Compatible with vanilla Minecraft

A small joke pack for players who would rather heal with chicken nuggets than apples.
